evidence.quoted_text: If main has advanced, use a release candidate branch/tag at the exact SHA.
evidence.reason: At the current tip, line 185 tells operators to use a release candidate branch/tag at the exact SHA when main has advanced, but the runbook's dispatches still hardcode --ref main: install-matrix at line 162 and pack-audit at line 207. The poll compares the run's head_sha to FINAL_02_SHA, so a dispatch on an advanced main exits head-sha-mismatch; the fallback cannot be followed as written without editing the blocks.
